description: A crescent prism one high, its two top arcs chamfered at 0.1 so that the stripes meet on their own section from the top's contact (-1.7, -0.8485, 1) down to the spine at (-2, 0, 0.9) (the mutual trim, ADR-0084), the cusp vertex gone. Its common with the box [-3, -3, -1]-[3, -0.6, 2], whose plane y = -0.6 crosses both stripes and the section edge: all of the crescent but its tip. The section edge is the cone/cone (or torus/torus) section fitted within SECTION_FIT_FRACTION of the linear tolerance, 2.5e-8 (ADR-0042, ADR-0062); where the cut puts a vertex on it that error no longer cancels between the two faces, so the fixture's volume and inertia are held at 5e-9, not the default 1e-9. A 20-digit quadrature of the chamfered height field gives the exact volume, 3.43807192675: Open CASCADE is 1e-11 off it and Arris's body 2.3e-9 in memory.
